metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: AI-Assisted Case Triage Procurement
decision.domain: Artificial intelligence, AI ethics, technology policy, and public-sector governance
decision.question: Choose whether and how to use AI for benefit-case triage while preserving accuracy, privacy, group equity, contestability, and fiscal feasibility.
blocking_reasons: the winner is sensitive to criterion weights
evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

current-manual.label: Current manual triage
current-manual.description: Retain staff-led triage with existing rules and quality assurance.

vendor-black-box.label: Vendor black-box automation
vendor-black-box.description: Procure a proprietary end-to-end model with automated case routing.

open-model-human.label: Auditable model with human review
open-model-human.description: Use an inspectable model for prioritization while preserving trained human decisions, appeals, and monitoring.

rules-assist.label: Rules-based staff assistant
rules-assist.description: Improve data validation, queueing, and checklist support without predictive case scoring.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic benchmark, red-team, and service-design estimates
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
sources: Illustrative offline benchmark by claimant group
evidence.causal_claim_status: No causal claim; task-benefit and harm inputs are prospective scenario estimates.
limitations: Offline error rates may not predict outcomes after staff adapt to the system.
Contestability and dignity are represented imperfectly by numerical scores.
Security threats and vendor lock-in are simplified.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A real procurement should include participatory impact assessment, security testing, accessibility review, and a non-AI alternative.
Automation must not remove meaningful notice, explanation, or appeal.
